name: Somnath Lahiri
contribution: Somnath Lahiri was a communist leader and legislator who brought a sharp left critique of state power and constitutional authority into postcolonial politics.
context: His interventions challenged communalism, colonial continuities, and restrictions on civil rights in the making of the new state.
impact: He represents a Bengali political tradition that treated constitutional freedom and economic justice as inseparable.
